baseline.normalization: SQLite FTS5 unicode61 tokenization with default diacritic folding; titles are not indexed.
baseline.queryPolicy: Remove current FTS5 operators, quote every whitespace token, run AND then deduplicated OR fallback; do not remove high-frequency words. Rewritten query is used when present. Snapshot/today use the current ordered allow-list hydration path.

lexicalPolicy.coreTermNormalization: Split on non-alphanumeric Unicode characters, lowercase, fold common Portuguese diacritics, preserve names and numeric tokens, then remove only the fixed language-specific list.
lexicalPolicy.selectionRule: Fixed closed lists only; never infer stopwords per user corpus. Empty core queries fall back to the untouched query. Proper-name and numeric tokens are never removed unless they exactly equal a listed function word.
